title: Concept: Phoenix LiveDashboard exposed
description: A Phoenix LiveDashboard route in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: LiveDashboard lists every process, ETS table and configuration value in the node, including connection settings, and it is mounted without authentication by default.
applicability: Deployments that render a Phoenix LiveDashboard route into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: LiveDashboard lists every process, ETS table and configuration value in the node, including connection settings, and it is mounted without authentication by default.
